displayDescription: Full quality-and-risk analysis of requirement documents (single- or multi-source), producing one gap/conflict register with executable P0/P1 verification. Triggers: requirements analyzer, requirement quality, gap register, 需求分析, 需求分析器, 需求评审, 需求缺口. Not for writing a case library (that is testcase-generation), constructing test data (testdata-generation), or reviewing code (defect-detection / code-reviewer).
